## Notes

Name spelled "Duncan Neil." Dated 20th November 1840.
Names the following:

- "beloved wife Betty"
- son James Neil: leaves land on Duck River
- "my two youngest James Neil and Angeline Neil" to be educated from proceeds of selling land
- Elizabeth Neil
- hard paragraph to read names Thomas Neil, Ellen Campbell, Alexander Neil, Mary Oldfield, Nancy Oldfield, Susan Hardaway, Rachel Yell, Angeline Neil and James Neil
- Alexander Neil is executor
